given: A clip-first composition has tts tracks with real audio data and subtitle_timeline tracks from nftts.
when: The desktop editor opens the composition and the user presses play.
then: The preview plays audible voice and export muxes an audio stream.

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf export --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-clip-first --profile draft --diagnostics --out ../NextFrame.archive/v0.21.0-verify/showreel-clip-first-audio-datauri.mp4 | jq '.audio_muxed'
